subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR with a proof-backed same-repo fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the bug and same-repo PRs are closed, but the remaining open closing reference is a non-maintainer-modifiable fork PR rather than a normal upstream landing path.

options.title: Adopt or replace upstream
options.body: Use the linked fork PR only as source material, then land a same-repo fix with real Control UI proof.

options.title: Wait on fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue open until the external PR author provides proof and a maintainable upstream path.

options.title: Close without fixing
options.body: This would leave current main and the latest release with the same confusing Channels page behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace upstream
recommendation.body: Use the linked fork PR only as source material, then land a same-repo fix with real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently touched the localized Control UI channels file that now owns the resolver path.
